trello.name: Add queue depth alerting for worker fleet
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Add queue depth alerts across the entire worker fleet, not just payments, with the same thresholds everywhere: warning at 1,000 jobs and page at 5,000 jobs. Do it in one pass. Acceptance criteria: all worker queues have alerting configured at the specified thresholds.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic with backoff and dead-letter queue
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Fix the retry logic in payment_worker.py, specifically the _process_with_retry function. Current behavior retries five times back to back with no backoff or jitter, and on the fifth failure re-enqueues the job at the front of the queue, causing retry storms. Requirements: implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap the retries, and send failed jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back rather than the front of the main queue. Also add tests that simulate processor 503s to cover this scenario.

trello.name: Bump and split DB connection pool for workers and API
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. The DB connection pool is at the default of 20 connections, which was exhausted when workers piled up, causing the API to fail. In one change (same config file): bump the pool to 100 as a stopgap, and split the worker and API connection pools so they no longer share. Acceptance criteria: worker and API pools are separate, pool size set to 100.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Owner: Priya (Kofi to confirm with her after the meeting). Update the payment incident runbook to address issues Priya encountered on call. Requirements: replace old Kibana logging links (turned off in March) with current logging links, document the queue drain procedure Kofi improvised during Tuesday's outage, and verify escalation phone numbers are current (one still routes to someone who left last year). Acceptance criteria: runbook has valid logging links, documented queue drain procedure, and verified/current escalation contacts.

trello.name: Automate status page updates on checkout error rate alert
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. The status page is currently updated manually, which caused a delay until minute 30 during the outage. Automate it: when the checkout error rate alert fires, the status page should flip to 'investigating' automatically with a template message. The status provider has an API. Scope for now: wire it to the checkout alert first; can extend to other alerts later. Acceptance criteria: checkout error rate alert triggers an automatic status page update to 'investigating' with a template message.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Draft a plan for a controlled chaos game day test of the payment processor failover. The secondary payment processor is configured but has never been exercised. Plan should cover staging first, then production during a low-traffic window, with a rollback plan. Deadline: draft ready for review in two weeks. No execution until the plan is reviewed. Acceptance criteria: a written game day plan is drafted and ready for team review in two weeks; no execution occurs prior to review.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis from EOL 6.0 to 7.2
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Current Redis version is 6.0, which reached end of life with security fixes ending in June. Upgrade to 7.2. This is a minor migration but includes a config rename and changed persistence defaults, so it requires a proper change window, not a casual Friday deploy. Schedule it with the infra calendar. Acceptance criteria: Redis upgraded to 7.2 via a scheduled change window.

trello.name: Write and distribute outage timeline doc
trello.desc: Owner: Ines. Write up the timeline document for Tuesday's outage and send it out tomorrow. Acceptance criteria: timeline doc is written tonight and distributed the next day.
